log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Pelipper

decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper+Damp Rock sets rain on entry; Mega Blastoise Water Spout in rain hits both foes at ~225 effective BP before spread reduction. Wide Guard blocks Heat Wave/Population Bomb spread. Backline Toxapex special-walls Scarf Dragapult Shadow Ball and Basculegion Wave Crash with Regenerator pivots; Houndoom Flash Fire pivots into Hisuian Arcanine Flare Blitz/Head Smash and threatens Dragapult/Annihilape with Dark Pulse. Sneasler and Altaria stay benched for late Unburden sweep and Dragon/Grou
decisions.notebook: Opponent team profile: Scarf Dragapult (Infiltrator, 178-213 Spe), Maushold (Focus Sash, Friend Guard, Follow Me, 144-179 Spe), Adaptability Basculegion (Life Orb, Wave Crash/Last Respects/Aqua Jet, 98-130 Spe), Mega Floette-Eternal (Light of Ruin 140 BP, Flower Veil, 112-144 Spe), Hisuian Arcanine (Expert Belt, Intimidate, Extreme Speed priority, 121-156 Spe), Annihilape (Defiant, Rage Fist snowball, 110-142 Spe). No Swift Swim on Basculegion - rain speed boost not a factor. Plan: rain mode with Pelipper+Blastoise lead, Water Spout spread pressure. Toxapex walls Dragapult/Basculegion special. Houndoom pivots Arcanine. Sneasler Unburden late sweep after White Herb Close Combat. Altaria covers Dragons and Ground immunity with Charti Berry for Arcanine Rock coverage.

decisions.rationale: Mega Floette intended. Lead Floette+Maushold: T1 Follow Me + LoR/Moonblast pressures Sneasler/Altaria/Houndoom while FG blunts spreads; back Basculegion rain Wave Crash + Scarf Pult speed/Ghost/Fire clean and U-turn. Covers rain spout, Unburden, and Toxapex better than Annihilape/Arcanine cores.
decisions.notebook: Opp rain core Pelipper+Mega Blastoise, Sneasler Unburden WhiteHerb, Toxapex Regenerator WG/Haze, Houndoom FlashFire NP, Altaria Charti NaturalCure. My core: Mega Floette Aura + Bascu LO Adapt rain + Maushold FG Follow + Scarf Pult. Arcanine Intim/ES and Annihilape Defiant RageFist as flex. Prioritize breaking rain setters and Sneasler; respect WideGuard and Haze. Future: track Sneasler item consume and Blastoise mega timing.

decisions.rationale: Water Spout in rain (150 BP * 1.5 rain * 0.75 spread = ~169 effective) should OHKO Floette even through Friend Guard reduction. Pelipper Hydro Pump on Floette either hits directly or gets redirected to Maushold by Follow Me, breaking Focus Sash so Water Spout double-KOs. Not Mega Evolving: Mega Launcher doesn't boost Water Spout/Hydro Pump, and Blastoise-Mega drops to 135 SpA which weakens the spread.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team confirmed: Scarf Dragapult (Infiltrator), Maushold (Focus Sash, Friend Guard, Follow Me), Adaptability Basculegion (Life Orb, no Swift Swim), Mega Floette-Eternal (Light of Ruin, Flower Veil), Hisuian Arcanine (Expert Belt, Intimidate, Extreme Speed), Annihilape (Defiant, Rage Fist). Rain mode plan: Pelipper+Blastoise lead with Water Spout spread pressure. Blastoise-Mega is a downgrade for Water Spout (lower SpA, no relevant ability boost) - stay base forme for rain mode. Toxapex walls special Dragons/Water. Houndoom pivots Arcanine with Flash Fire. Late sweep plan with Sneasler Unburden after White Herb Close Combat. Altaria Charti Berry covers Arcanine Rock coverage.

decisions.rationale: Toxapex is the safest switch. It walls Basculegion (resists Wave Crash), Dragapult (neutral/resists Ghost-Dragon-Fire), Annihilape (resists Fighting), and only fears Head Smash from Arcanine-Hisui. Regenerator lets it pivot later. Blastoise passes to maintain Water Spout pressure in rain. Houndoom is too frail and outsped by Scarf Dragapult.

decisions.rationale: Water Spout at 100% HP in rain hits both foes: KOs Maushold (1%) and chunks Basculegion 22-50%. Wide Guard blocks Basculegion's Wave Crash (the biggest threat at 20-38% on Toxapex). No Mega: Water Spout doesn't benefit from Mega Launcher and SpA drops 150→135. Wide Guard preserves Toxapex HP while Water Spout pressures the board.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Maus 1% dies to anything; Follow Me redirects so Bascu can Last Respects (Ghost, +1 faint) Blastoise through rain. Wave Crash resisted by both Waters. Protect wastes tempo vs full HP backline. Force damage on Mega threat before WG/Haze cycles.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Aqua Jet priority means Basculegion always moves before Houndoom. Attacking risks Houndoom taking 80-165% damage (Aqua Jet 58-85% + Dragapult 22-80%), likely fainting my win condition. Protect guarantees Houndoom survives at 100% HP while Toxapex walls the hits (29-66% from Draco Meteor, 5-10% from Aqua Jet NVE) and pressures Basculegion to 73% HP. Next turn I keep both Pokémon alive to fight Dragapult and weakened Basculegion.
decisions.notebook: Rain mode: Pelipper+Blastoise fainted T1-T2 to Adaptability Basculegion Last Respects and FocusSash Maushold Follow Me redirect. Remaining: Toxapex (special wall, Wide Guard) + Houndoom (Flash Fire pivot, Timid 162 SpA). Key threat: Scarf Adaptability Basculegion with Aqua Jet priority outspeeds Houndoom's offense. Opponent back: Annihilape (Defiant, Rage Fist) and Hisuian Arcanine (Intimidate, ExpertBelt, ExtremeSpeed priority). Future: need to play around Basculegion Aqua Jet priority—Houndoom must Protect or KO Basculegion in one shot when safe. Houndoom Dark Pulse OHKOes both Basculegion and Dragapult from full but priority Aqua Jet means it lands first. Annihilape Defiant punishes Intimidate plays. Arcanine-Hisui ExtremeSpeed priority threatens Houndoom.

decisions.rationale: Wave Crash still OHKOs Houndoom through -1 Atk in rain+LO+Adapt; Scarf Pult outspeeds and chips Toxapex. Must remove Dark Pulse threat now; Aqua Jet not guaranteed KO. Flash Fire blocks Fire into Doom.

decisions.rationale: Aqua Jet priority OHKOes Houndoom regardless of my play, so attacking gives a 20% chance to KO Basculegion and win while Protect only delays the inevitable. Dark Pulse does 51.5-95.4% to Basculegion at 73% HP—possible KO if opponent doesn't Aqua Jet. Toxapex Recover heals for solo survival if Houndoom faints, or for the 2v2 if Basculegion is KOed.

decisions.rationale: Toxapex at 32% SpD-1 is near-dead to Dragapult's locked Shadow Ball (SE Ghost). Houndoom fainted, no ally to Wide Guard, no switches. Haze resets Basculegion's -3 Atk (bad). Chilling Water NVE 0.5x won't KO either foe. Recover is the only play that gives a chance to survive the hit and stay in the game; if I faint regardless, no other line changes the outcome.

Opponent back is Annihilape (Defiant Rage Fist) and Hisuian Arcanine (Intimidate ExpertBelt ExtremeSpeed) - both unused. Dragapult Choice Scarf Timid Infiltrator. Basculegion Adaptability Life Orb Adamant, Atk -3 from Toxapex chip. Key lesson: lead rain mode lost to Adaptability Last Respects sweep and FocusSash redirect - need to scout Adaptability users and avoid giving free Follow Me turns.

reflections.summary: Lost because the rain-mode lead (Pelipper+Blastoise-Mega) was a poor matchup into this squad: Floette-Mega Light of Ruin OHKOed Pelipper T1 before rain could stabilize, Maushold Follow Me gave Floette a free redirect turn, and Basculegion's Adaptability Last Respects snowballed once Maushold and Floette fainted, sweeping Blastoise T2 and Houndoom T4. reflections.adjustment: For game 2, abandon the rain lead entirely. Lead Toxapex + Houndoom (Houndoom's Flash Fire lets it absorb Basculegion's Wave Crash for a SpA boost and threaten a Fire Blast KO on the -3 Atk Basculegion). Keep Pelipper in the back to set rain only after Basculegion is removed, and bring a Dark- or Ghost-resistant pivot (or a Fake Out user) to handle Choice Scarf Dragapult's Shadow Ball spam that deleted Toxapex. Do not re-Mega Blastoise unless Basculegion is already down — consider a different Me
reflections.notebook:
Series 9eefe47ddd99 — durable notes after G1 loss:

Opponent tendencies / revealed facts:
- Leads with a redirect core (Maushold Follow Me + Fairy Aura Mega) to enable a big nuke (Light of Ruin) into my lead.
- Backs the redirect core with Adaptability Life Orb Basculegion Adamant carrying Last Respects — sweeps once 2+ teammates faint. Resists Water, so rain Water Spouts are wasted on it.
- Dragapult is Choice Scarf Timid Infiltrator, Shadow Ball spam into the special wall (Toxapex). Locks itself in, so pivoting around it is viable.
- Back pocket: Annihilape (Defiant Adamant Rage Fist) and Hisuian Arcanine (Intimidate Expert Belt Jolly, ExtremeSpeed) — neither used G1; expect at least one in G2, likely Annihilape to punish my Atk-droping Toxapex play or Arcanine for Intimidate chip into Basculegion.
- Opponent will Protect Basculegion when low (used T5 at 30%) — don't commit both attackers to it in one turn.

Future plans:
- Do NOT lead Pelipper+Blastoise-Mega into this squad again. Rain mode loses to Follow Me redirect + Adaptability Last Respects snowball.
- Preferred lead: Toxapex + Houndoom. Houndoom's Flash Fire turns Basculegion's Wave Crash into a free SpA boost; Fire Blast threatens the -3 Atk Basculegion for a KO.
- Keep Pelipper in back; bring rain online only after Basculegion is removed.
- Reconsider the Mega slot — Blastoise-Mega contributed nothing this game. A faster or more disruptive Mega (or no Mega, freeing a different Pokémon) is likely correct.
- Need a Dark/Ghost resist or a Fake Out user to handle Choice Scarf Dragapult Shadow Ball pressure on Toxape

reflections.summary: Won because Follow Me enabled Floette to delete Pelipper then Bascu Last Respects immediately deleted Mega Blastoise, after which Scarf Pult + Wave Crash cleaned the remaining Toxapex/Houndoom despite Atk drops.
reflections.adjustment: Question G1 preview: Mega Floette+Maushold lead is fragile into their rain Water Spout even with Follow Me (crit ended it instantly); next game bring a different four or delay Mega/Floette and prioritize safer rain-breaker pressure.

Brings rain+ Tox+Doom; Tox spams Chilling Water Atk drops, both Pelipper/Tox have WG, Doom Protects then Fire Blast. My core: Mega Floette Aura + Bascu LO Adapt + Maushold FG Follow + Scarf Pult Infiltrator. Prioritize rain setters and Sneasler; respect WG/Haze. G1 Floette lead died to rain Spout crit—reconsider that preview matchup.
